## The question

Can we predict cholesterol accurately from other nutritional information and the restaurant a food comes from? Which nutrients are the most influential? Answering these questions will inform consumers of fast food and spread awareness on fast food health. Our response variable is cholesterol (mg), and some of the important candidate predictors include company, calories, total fat, saturated fat, sodium, carbs, fibers, sugars, and proteins.

## What the baseline shows

**Describe and justify a simple course-based baseline regression model. Interpret the result that best establishes the rest of the story, including its direction, magnitude, scale, and uncertainty. Explain one limitation or unresolved pattern that motivates deeper analysis.**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(RKaggle)
fastfood <- RKaggle::get_dataset("ulrikthygepedersen/fastfood-nutrition")
fastfood_mod = lm(cholesterol ~ calories + cal_fat + total_fat + sat_fat + trans_fat + sodium + total_carb + fiber + sugar + protein, data=fastfood)

summary(fastfood_mod)
```
